<start_of_turn>user
Respond in JSON format, either with `tool_call` (a request to call tools) or with `response` reply to the user's request

You can call any of the following tools to satisfy the user's requests: [
  {
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get the current weather for a city",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "Paris",
              "Berlin",
              "London",
              "Tokyo"
            ],
            "description": "City name"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "location"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
      "name": "get_time",
      "description": "Get the time in a time zone",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "zone": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "Tokyo",
              "Paris",
              "New York"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "zone"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
      "name": "get_stock_price",
      "description": "Get a stock's last price",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "symbol": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "AAPL",
              "MSFT",
              "GOOG"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "symbol"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
]

Example tool call syntax:

{
  "tool_calls": [
    {
      "name": "tool_name",
      "arguments": {
        "arg1": "some_value"
      },
      "id": "call_1___"
    }
  ]
}<end_of_turn>



What is the weather in Paris right now?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
{
  "tool_calls": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "arguments": {
        "location": "Paris"
      },
      "id": "call_1"
    }
  ]
}<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>user
{
  "tool_response": {
    "content": "21 C and sunny",
    "tool_call_id": "call_1"
  }
}<end_of_turn>
